release_checks: Native build and regression tests for each published platform and architecture
Clean-host startup, fonts, database read/write, numerical workflow and export
macOS deployment target, architecture, signing and Gatekeeper behavior
Linux X11/XWayland startup and runtime dependency closure
Public GitHub release check and checksum verification
Matching project and dependency sources, license texts and copyright notices
Redistribution basis for bundled scientific datasets, including La2004/La2010 orbital tables
release_checks_scope: Required checks, not completed or pending status declarations.

validation.scope: Current documentation checks, latest algorithm/UI regression and historical packaging/platform evidence have separate scopes and logs. Final native packages and remote downloads require release-specific acceptance.

help.fallback: GitHub main branch, matching document path and anchor

readiness.third_party_notice_collection: automated with dependency/source provenance checks; native package runs still required
readiness.corresponding_source_publication: required alongside binaries; remote artifacts not verified
readiness.data_redistribution: La2004/La2010 basis requires confirmation; see docs/third_party.md
